name: Pousada de Lisboa - Praça do Comercio
insider_take: This stunning pousada occupies a prime corner of Lisbon's most magnificent square, where royal palaces once stood before the great 1755 earthquake reshaped the city forever.
whats_special: You're staying in the heart of Pombaline architecture on Praça do Comércio, Europe's largest waterfront square. The hotel's neoclassical façade is part of the carefully planned reconstruction following the devastating earthquake that destroyed much of Lisbon. The Tagus River literally laps at your doorstep, and you're surrounded by the elegant arcades that house some of the city's most prestigious shops and cafés.
pro_tip: Wake up early to have the magnificent square almost to yourself – sunrise over the Tagus from your window is pure magic, and you'll catch the locals heading to work before the tourist crowds arrive.
dont_miss: The triumphant Rua Augusta Arch is just steps away – take the elevator to the top for panoramic views. The historic Cais do Sodré ferry terminal nearby offers scenic rides across the Tagus, and the atmospheric Rua Augusta pedestrian street leads directly into Lisbon's charming Baixa district with its famous elevators and traditional shops.
pros: Prime location directly on iconic Praça do Comercio
Historic building with elegant Portuguese architecture
Walking distance to major Lisbon attractions
Stunning views of the Tagus River and square
cons: Historic building may have limited modern amenities
